observations: A large wooden wardrobe unit with a light oak finish, consisting of a central section with two sliding doors and open shelving, flanked by open shelving and drawer units on both sides.
The central section has one door open, revealing multiple shelves with handbags, shoes, and small decorative items.
The left side has three open shelves and four drawers with round knobs; the right side has three open shelves and one drawer with a handle.
The wardrobe is placed in a bedroom with a bed in the foreground, patterned flooring, and a wall-mounted light fixture.
A floral-patterned bag is placed on top of the wardrobe.
The photos are watermarked with 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'CHEMYABIODUN'.
